versions.name: Camp David Wortman
versions.summary: A rustic, primitive Sequoia Council camp in the Sierra Nevada foothills near Badger, California, adjacent to national forest land, with wooded campsites, hiking trails, and a small lodge for unit camping and outdoor activities.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Sequoia Council camp page (the source's sequoiabsa.org/wortman link does not resolve). Confirmed as a current Sequoia Council primitive unit-camping property near Badger. Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate; elevation from open-meteo.
